public.published_tours.name: published_tours
public.published_tours.definition: SELECT id, name, slug, price, currency, duration, location, featured, popular FROM tours WHERE status = 'published'::enum_tours_status ORDER BY featured DESC, name

public.featured_testimonials.name: featured_testimonials
public.featured_testimonials.definition: SELECT id, author_name, author_location, rating, review_text, platform, date FROM testimonials WHERE visibility_featured = true ORDER BY rating DESC, date DESC

public.published_stories.name: published_stories
public.published_stories.definition: SELECT id, title, slug, author_id, excerpt, published_date, status FROM stories WHERE status = 'published'::enum_stories_status ORDER BY published_date DESC

public.content_overview.name: content_overview
public.content_overview.definition: SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM tours WHERE tours.status = 'published'::enum_tours_status) AS published_tours, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM tours WHERE tours.status = 'draft'::enum_tours_status) AS draft_tours, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM stories WHERE stories.status = 'published'::enum_stories_status) AS published_stories, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM testimonials) AS total_testimonials, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM vendors WHERE vendors.status = 'published'::enum_vendors_status) AS published_vendors, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM vendors WHERE vendors.status = 'draft'::enum_vendors_status) AS draft_vendors
